name: wacrm-ai-evals
description: Isolated from the root package.json on purpose — promptfoo and its dependency tree must never appear in the root package-lock.json the production Dockerfile installs from. See run.ts's own comment for the incident that made this necessary (2026-09-16: promptfoo's optional @huggingface/transformers → onnxruntime-node, ~211MB, pushed a Docker build from ~2-3min to 6+min and crashed the build host).
